annotation.title_clean: モビリティ・ロードマップ 2024 －新たなモビリティサービスの事業化に向けた基本的な考え方と施策－
annotation.title_en: Mobility Roadmap 2024: Basic Approach and Measures for Commercialization of New Mobility Services
annotation.authors_or_issuer: デジタル社会推進会議 モビリティワーキンググループ (Digital Society Promotion Council, Mobility Working Group, Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Mobility Working Group roadmap for commercializing autonomous driving and new mobility services (drones, service robots) across short-, medium- and long-term stages (2024–2027+), covering business models, technology and institutional rules, including clarification of legal liability for autonomous vehicle accidents and transparent permit review procedures.
key_provisions_or_claims: Three-stage roadmap: demonstration (FY2024), early commercialization (FY2025-26), full commercialization (FY2027+).
Double year-round Level 4 autonomous driving operations to 20+ locations in FY2024.
Document transparent, fair permit review procedures under Road Traffic Act and Road Transport Vehicle Act.
Clarify social rules on liability, accident investigation and compensation for autonomous vehicles.
Develop V2X/V2N, safety evaluation environments and coordinated control of vehicles, service robots and drones.
